meta.title: A submitted bid and its products are persisted with the right prices
gaps: Verification of each product row's price matching the submitted price specifically is not expressible with the available read fields

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor opens a bid on the pricing round.
The invited QA vendor prices the line on the bid at 100.
As the invited QA vendor, read the pricing round and check that “bid count” is at least 1.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: “bid count” is at least 1.

plan.title: A submitted bid and its products are persisted with the right prices
